subject: Great House Farm, Llandough, Nr Penarth, Vale of Glamorgan
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Sirs/Ma'am, Please cite the link displaying the record of petition of
demolition of great house farm in Llandough near Penarth. I have a
newspaper article from 1978 citing the petition. It says 1,000 signatures,
in other references it says 1700. Regards, Requester
